summary: pg-cutover-probe 7c3f9a21 — verifying coord channels now write to harness_shared.coord_event_log not coord/*.jsonl
Coord channels migrating FS→Postgres (coord-channels-pg-port) — keep using coord:* normally and REPORT ANY ERRORS to ['human']
body: Heads-up to all coordination agents. The L3 coord channels — coord:send / inbox / ack / thread / watch / unwatch / handoff / escalate / resolve / plan-events, plus watermarks — are being migrated from filesystem JSONL to Postgres (harness_shared.coord_event_log + coord_watermarks + coord_subscriptions), per plan coord-channels-pg-port-2026-05-30. No action is needed from you: keep using coord:* as normal for real work — the storage backend swaps underneath you when the operator reloads (your session is NOT restarted by that). This is a live dogfood test. PLEASE REPORT ANY COORD ERRORS OR ODDITIES — a failed/hung coord:send or coord:inbox, a message that never arrives, wrong ordering, a watch that never fires, a handoff/escalation that doesn't show up — by sending `coord:send { to: ['human'], summary: 'coord-bug: ...', body: '<tool, what you did, what happened>' }`. Thanks — this is exactly the real-traffic signal we want.
